name: NS Solutions Corporation
summary: NS Solutions Corporation provides information technology solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers business and information system consultation services; planning, design, development, implementation, operation, and maintenance of information system; and development, manufacturing, sales, and rental of software and hardware related to information systems; and provision of outsourcing services using information technology and various other services.
